title: Autonom land Multiverse
description:
Discover the bold story of an open-world warrior on a mission of vengeance, all his own.

Autonom Land: Multiverse

The Island of Echoes is a standalone experience set in the future. The story follows a lone fighter named Sam Graves — nickname "Ghost" — thirsty for revenge. 

He travels through the beautiful, rugged landscapes of the northern lands, hunting those who hurt his family years earlier, and fights to survive as one of the lost colony of Albine against dangerous zombies, military mercenaries, and ominous aliens. 

Strange alien shapes and hostile ruins set the stage for a fast-paced, cinematic action experience where every encounter demands precision and adaptability.

Combat unfolds as a fluid dance of dodges, shields, and parries, paired with a high-tech arsenal built from human and Alien weaponry. Master enemy patterns, evolve your strategy, and face off against spectacular bosses that push every skill to the edge — and travel across the entire multiverse.

FEATURES• 🌎 Open-world islands to explore

• 🔫 Shooter and survival gameplay

• 🚗 Vehicles and exploration

• 🎯 Missions and objectives

• 🤖 AI-controlled NPCs and enemies

• 🏙️ Cities, towns and industrial areas

• 🪖 Military bases and dangerous locations

• 🌦️ Dynamic environmental and weather systems

• 🗺️ Interactive rotatable map with real-time icons for enemies, buildings, vehicles, and loot

• 🔎 Exploration, discovery, and travel across other islands and hidden worlds

•  An in-game smartphone lets you take screenshots, play your favorite songs from your own music folder, browse your photo gallery, and access other handy gameplay features.

Autonom Lands is an independent open-world game, solo-developed over six years. The island continues to grow — new gameplay systems and content are planned in future updates, with much more still to discover.

Enter Autonom Lands. Explore the island. Survive. And discover what is waiting for you. 

-Beyond the Island of Echoes, deeper threats and entirely New worlds await those willing to go further — a frozen island lost to the dead, a desert stronghold ruled by war, and worlds beyond this one entirely.
description_short: A lone fighter awakens in a dangerous world where human and alien forces collide. Explore rugged landscapes, master deadly weapons, survive relentless encounters, and uncover a path through the multiverse. Fight, explore, and discover what lies beyond your world.
